lit-world-03-c3.text: Joshua J. Mark (2020). Rumi. World History Encyclopedia.
lit-world-03-c3.quote: Jalal ad-Din Muhammad Rumi (also given as Jalal ad-did Muhammad Balkhi, best known as Rumi, l. 1207-1273 CE) was a Persian Islamic theologian and scholar but became famous as a mystical poet
lit-world-03-c3.claim: Rumi (1207-1273) is the central mystical poet.
